programmes.d: Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E8 - That Old Black Magic
programmes.d: Crichton's spirit is captured by Maldis. The sorcerer thrives on vengeance and hate, he brings Crais's spirit down. And the two spirits battle.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E9 - DNA Mad Scientist
programmes.d: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew, promising them that he would be able to use it to find the location of their home planets.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E10 - They've Got A Secret
programmes.d: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute, destroys a Peacekeeper shield and gets ejected into open space.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E11 - 'Til The Blood Runs Clear
programmes.d: While flying Crichton's ship near a sun with high flare activity, John and Aeryn narrowly avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E12 - The Flax
programmes.d: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but unfortunately they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E13 - Rhapsody In Blue
programmes.d: The crew finds a colony of Delvians. Z'han goes down to be with her own people for a while, but one of them wants something from Z'han.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E14 - Jeremiah Crichton
programmes.d: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E15 - Durka Returns
programmes.d: When a Starburst goes badly wrong, Moya collides with a Nebari ship.
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E16 - A Human Reaction
programmes.d: When Moya travels to an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth, Crichton leaves on Farscape One in the hopes of returning home.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E17 - Through The Looking Glass
programmes.d: Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can. It goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E18 - A Bug's Life
programmes.d: A peacekeeper ship is approaching Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base the Peacekeeper mentioned.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E20 - The Hidden Memory
programmes.d: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind, while Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E21 - Bone To Be Wild
programmes.d: The crew finds a planetoid that's a botanical paradise. Occupied by a scientist and a peaceful girl. But one is a killer.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E22 - Family Ties
programmes.d: With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes, and share a last feast together.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby
programmes.d: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them. Their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E2 - Vitas Mortis
programmes.d: D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone
programmes.d: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by reckless thrill seekers who play dangerous and life-threatening games.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter
programmes.d: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya. The crew welcomes him on board, but soon almost everyone is acting paranoid.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't
programmes.d: Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot. After seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will
programmes.d: Chiana buys a picture in a store, which is more than it seems. The picture changes and shows Chiana what will happen to her.
The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
programmes.d: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn seems to have a tolerance for the spores.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
programmes.d: While waiting for Moya to pick their Transport Pod, Zhaan tells Crichton of Moya's adventures after the Gammak base was destroyed.
Crichton, Aeryn and Crais are welcomed aboard Scorpius' carrier; Scorpius promises amnesty in exchange for wormhole technology; Scorpius threatens to destroy something close to Crichton's heart.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
programmes.d: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast makes it through and causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.
An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
programmes.d: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programmes.d: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.
Danish Crichton tries to survive aboard the Elack; a female alien and mercenaries are keen to harvest Elack's neural tissue.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programmes.d: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
